name: wondermint-marketplace
description: Interact with Wondermint, including REST-only direct marketplace buying, publishing, access, downloads, and analytics workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Wondermint plus REST-only direct marketplace workflows.
interface.longDescription: Wondermint Marketplace is the expanded Wondermint skill variant for documented REST-only direct marketplace workflows. It starts from the core skill and adds separate flows for buying, publishing, access/downloads, and non-auction analytics while excluding GraphQL, auctions, bids, offers, operator workflows, account linking, payouts, settlements, and earnings.
